situations.title: RASS 척도 사정
situations.tagline: 환자는 이름을 부르자 눈을 잠깐 뜨고 다시 감는다.
situations.brief: RASS 척도로 목표 진정도를 판단하고 환자의 각성 수준을 정확히 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's score his RASS together before we adjust the drip.
He opens his eyes to voice but doesn't sustain it.
That puts him at about a minus two, lightly sedated.

situations.title: 프로포폴 주입 관리
situations.tagline: Can you double-check the propofol rate with me? The pump's reading twenty-five.
situations.brief: 프로포폴 주입 농도를 확인하고 활력징후 모니터를 함께 점검하세요.
keyPhrases: The propofol is running at twenty-five micrograms per kilo per minute.
Let's confirm the concentration on the bag matches the pump.
I'll watch his blood pressure while you titrate.
goals: 주입 농도와 펌프 설정을 교차 확인한다

situations.title: 통증 우선 평가
situations.tagline: 환자는 말은 못 하지만 흡인 처치 때마다 얼굴을 찡그린다.
situations.brief: analgesia-first 원칙에 따라 진정 전에 통증을 먼저 평가하고 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's treat his pain before we touch the sedation.
He grimaces with suctioning, so pain could be the driver.
Analgesia first, then we reassess the need for sedation.

situations.title: 진정 목표 설정 이해
situations.tagline: The plan is light sedation today — can you tell me what RASS we're aiming for?
situations.brief: light sedation 목표의 의미를 이해하고 목표 진정 범위를 설정하세요.
keyPhrases: Our goal today is light sedation, around zero to minus one.
We want him calm but able to follow simple commands.
Deeper isn't safer here, so let's hold that target.

situations.title: 진정 중 활력·기도 감시
situations.tagline: 진정 시작 후 환자의 호흡수가 분당 8회로 느려지고 있다.
situations.brief: 진정 중 호흡억제를 관찰하고 활력징후와 기도를 지속 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: His respiratory rate dropped to eight after the last bolus.
Let's watch his oxygen saturation and end-tidal CO2.
Have the airway equipment ready just in case.

situations.title: 진정제 라인·호환성 확인
situations.tagline: Before we add the new sedative, can we check it's compatible on that line?
situations.brief: 병용 약물의 라인 호환성을 점검하고 안전한 주입 경로를 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: Is this sedative compatible with what's already running?
Let's give it a dedicated lumen to be safe.
I'll check the compatibility chart before we start.

situations.title: RASS 목표 맞춤 적정
situations.tagline: He's swinging between too deep and too awake — how do you want to titrate?
situations.brief: 과진정과 저진정 사이에서 RASS 목표에 맞춰 진정을 세밀하게 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: He's at minus four now, that's deeper than our target.
Let's decrease the rate and reassess in fifteen minutes.
We're aiming for minus one to zero, not fully unresponsive.

situations.title: 덱스메데토미딘 적용
situations.tagline: We're starting dexmedetomidine — keep a close eye on his heart rate for me.
situations.brief: 덱스메데토미딘으로 협조적 진정을 유도하며 서맥을 함께 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: Dexmedetomidine gives cooperative sedation without much respiratory depression.
Watch for bradycardia and hypotension as we titrate.
He should still rouse and follow commands on this.

situations.title: 아편유사제 진통 적정
situations.tagline: 환자는 진통제 후에도 체위 변경 시 신음하며 얼굴을 찡그린다.
situations.brief: 아편유사제 진통을 적정하며 통증 완화와 호흡 안정의 균형을 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: He still grimaces with turning, so his pain isn't controlled.
Let's add a small bolus but watch his respiratory rate.
We balance comfort against oversedation and slow breathing.

situations.title: 프로포폴 장기 사용 감시
situations.tagline: He's been on propofol for four days now — his triglycerides are creeping up.
situations.brief: 프로포폴 장기 사용 중 중성지방과 PRIS 초기 징후를 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: His triglycerides are rising on prolonged propofol.
Let's check a lactate and watch for metabolic acidosis.
Early PRIS can look subtle, so we monitor closely.

situations.title: 진정 중단 이탈 연계
situations.tagline: Let's plan his sedation vacation this morning to prep for weaning.
situations.brief: 진정 중단을 계획하고 인공호흡기 이탈 준비로 연계하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll pause sedation for a spontaneous awakening trial.
If he stays calm, we can pair it with a breathing trial.
Watch closely so he doesn't get agitated or self-extubate.

situations.title: analgosedation 전략 적용
situations.tagline: Let's try an analgesia-based approach and keep sedatives to a minimum.
situations.brief: 진통을 기반으로 최소 진정을 유지하는 analgosedation 전략을 적용하세요.
keyPhrases: We prioritize analgesia and add sedation only if needed.
Good pain control often lowers the sedative requirement.
Let's reassess his comfort before increasing anything.
goals: 통증 조절 후 진정 필요성을 재평가한다

situations.title: 진정제 내성 용량 증가 관리
situations.tagline: His propofol dose keeps climbing but he's still not settled — thoughts?
situations.brief: 진정제 내성으로 용량이 증가할 때 대체 병용 전략을 검토하세요.
keyPhrases: He's tolerant and the dose keeps escalating.
Let's add a second agent instead of pushing propofol higher.
Combining agents can improve control at lower doses.

situations.title: 금단·알코올 병력 진정 조정
situations.tagline: 환자 아내가 남편이 매일 술을 많이 마셨다고 걱정스럽게 알려준다.
situations.brief: 알코올 병력을 반영해 예상 필요량을 예측하고 진정을 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: Thank you for telling me about his drinking history.
That helps us anticipate a higher sedation requirement.
We'll watch closely for withdrawal signs and adjust.

situations.title: 진정 깊이와 섬망 연계 관리
situations.tagline: He's been kept pretty deep — could that be feeding his delirium?
situations.brief: 과진정을 회피하며 진정 깊이와 섬망의 연계를 함께 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Deep sedation can worsen his delirium risk.
Let's lighten him toward our target and reassess.
Lighter sedation plus early mobility helps his brain.

situations.title: 프로포폴 주입 증후군 인지
situations.tagline: His lactate's up, he's acidotic, and the propofol's been high for days — I'm worried about PRIS.
situations.brief: 대사성 산증 징후로 프로포폴 주입 증후군을 인지하고 즉시 중단을 논의하세요.
keyPhrases: Rising lactate and acidosis on high-dose propofol suggest PRIS.
We need to stop the propofol now and switch agents.
Let's check a CK, potassium, and cardiac rhythm immediately.

situations.title: 과진정 호흡정지·저혈압 위기
situations.tagline: 환자가 무호흡에 빠지고 혈압이 급락하며 산소포화도가 떨어진다.
situations.brief: 과진정으로 인한 호흡정지와 저혈압에 즉시 감량하고 소생 처치를 시작하세요.
keyPhrases: He's apneic — stop the sedation and bag him now.
Pressure's crashing, let's start fluids and call for help.
Open the airway and support his breathing immediately.

situations.title: 신경근차단 병용 심부진정 관리
situations.tagline: He's paralyzed for the vent — we absolutely have to keep him deep so he's not aware.
situations.brief: 신경근차단 병용 시 심부진정을 유지해 각성 인지를 방지하세요.
keyPhrases: While he's paralyzed, we must ensure deep sedation.
A paralyzed patient can be aware if sedation is too light.
Let's confirm adequate sedation before every dose of paralytic.

situations.title: 진정 부족 자가발관 위험 급변
situations.tagline: 환자가 갑자기 손을 뻗어 기관튜브를 잡아당기려 몸부림친다.
situations.brief: 진정 부족으로 자가발관 위험이 급변할 때 안전을 확보하고 진정을 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: He's reaching for the tube — hold his hands, keep him safe.
Give a bolus now and reassess the drip rate.
Let's protect the airway before he pulls anything out.

situations.title: 덱스 서맥·저혈압 급변
situations.tagline: His heart rate just dropped into the thirties on the dex — pressure's falling too.
situations.brief: 덱스메데토미딘 중 서맥과 저혈압이 급변할 때 중단하고 즉시 처치하세요.
keyPhrases: His heart rate is in the thirties — pause the dexmedetomidine.
Let's give atropine and fluids and recheck the pressure.
Call the physician while I hold the infusion.

situations.title: 난치성 초조 위기 관리
situations.tagline: 환자가 어떤 진정에도 진정되지 않고 격렬하게 몸부림치며 장비를 뒤흔든다.
situations.brief: 난치성 초조 위기에 다약제와 안전 에스컬레이션으로 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: He's not settling despite multiple agents — let's escalate.
We need extra hands and a multimodal sedation plan.
Keep him and the lines safe while we get orders.
